answer: The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. Getting caught costs the farm a 40% cut on 75488 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. Where did the crystal come from? Who painted the onyx? When was the vine finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. There is one honest road in, and it runs through Hawk trainer hobby warrant flown at the hawking ground: the toll is each hobby is a measured quarry yield plus a falconer's signature, paid where everyone can watch.
